speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. You were born recently, and I see you have increasing yellowing of your eyes and skin; how many days old are you now, and when did you first notice this jaundice?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: That weight gain is excellent. Since the jaundice started after the first week, we must rule out breast milk jaundice or other pathological causes. Has your baby passed stool and urinated normally, and do you see any green stools? Also, please note if she appears lethargic or has poor feeding.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. I also have Exclusively breastfed, Brother died 3 months after liver surgery.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Bile Duct Atresia (progression to post-natal cholestasis with failure to thrive and history of sibling death from liver disease).

REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound, Hepatic_Scintigraphy
REQUEST TEST: Total_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin, Liver_Function_Panels, GGT
